name: Site Audit
description: Reviews a website across search performance, copy, load speed, accessibility, conversion and structured data, returning scored findings ranked P0 to P2 with a source URL behind each one. Repeats monthly and reports the change, and it won't fabricate figures it can't observe.

official.title: Site Audit by Andrej
official.description: SEO + content + speed + a11y + CRO + schema audit. Scored, P0/P1/P2, evidence URLs. Monthly diff. No invented metrics.
